newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich airport Jan-Aug cargo traffic down 1.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Zurich airport Jan-Aug cargo traffic down 1.4 pct.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Zurich airport in the first eight months of 1996 totalled 287,616 tonnes, a decrease of 1.4 percent on the same period last year, airport authority figures show.

January-August 1996 cargo traffic handled by Swiss airlines at Zurich airport declined by 4.6 percent on 1995 levels to 158,276 tonnes while foreign carriers' volume fell by 2.2 percent to 50,575 tonnes.
Trucked airfreight grew by 6.6 percent on January-August 1995, to 78,765 tonnes, the airport authority said.
January-August 1996 postal traffic totalled 10,679 tonnes, a fall of 2.2 percent.
